title: Probably not meant for skylights.
text: Probably not meant for skylights.. We really didn’t have an easy time with this - we wanted to shield three skylights from the summer sun, and it was not easy to install - not the film’s fault - maybe just covering a window was what it was meant for.  We were installing on hot glass as well, which made the adhering difficult - and we decide to scrap the project.

product_metadata.title: HIDBEA One Way Window Film, Daytime Privacy Sun Blocking Reflective Window Film No Glue Static Cling Heat Control Window Tinting Film for Home and Office, Black Silver, 35.4 x 196.8 Inch
features: Important to Know: This One Way Mirror Window Film Can Only Keep Privacy in the Daytime When the Light Intensity Outside is Stronger Than Inside. So When the Light is Turned on at Night, Draw Curtains If You Need Privacy.

DAYTIME WINDOW PRIVACY FILM: Attention about the privacy of one way window film, there is different privacy effect between daytime and night. When the outdoor light is stronger than indoor at daytime, the reflective window film provides a mirror effect, you can see out no one can see in. Note: When the inside light is stronger than the outside at night, the mirror effect will be reversed, people outside can see inside. Do remember to draw the curtain at night.

SUN BLOCKING & ANTI UV: Sun blocking window film can block 90% of harmful UV rays and 82% of infrared rays, preventing people's skin from aging and furniture from fading. 10% light transmission can effectively reduce glare and allow soft natural light to enter the room. Allowing you to maintain youthful skin while having privacy and a natural view.

HEAT CONTROL & ENERGY SAVING: Heat blocking window film can reflect 85% of the solar heat in summer, reduce heat entering the room and the temperature of air-conditioned rooms. Heat control window film keeps rooms warm in the winter by reducing the amount of warm air escaping and inhibiting cold air from going in. Thermal window film can help reduce the cost of expensive air conditioning, but cannot completely replace it.

STATIC CLING & WIDELY USED: Water is the most important installation tool. The more water you spray, the easier it will be to install. Our static cling window film is designed to be adhesive-free, with no chemical releases. You can easily install and remove without leaving any residue. Suitable for smooth and clean glass, such as Residential, stores, living rooms, offices, etc. For more information on how to install window film, you can refer to our video.

WORRY-FREE SHOPPING: 30 days no reason return policy guarantee . If you have any questions about our one way window film, please feel free to contact us, we will solved your problem within 24 hours. Our goal is to make every customer have a perfect shopping experience. Now click "Add to Cart" and get ready to decorate your home.
description: HIDBEA window film creates a private and comfortable space for you.

Paste the type from the indoor. Please do not use it for the rear view mirror of your car. Please do not use it as a mirror although it has a mirror effect. At night when the lighting is brighter inside than outside and you can see in, remember to draw the curtains.

Suitable for all smooth surface (non-bumpy) glass. Not suitable for rough surface and porous surface glass such as wood, tile or glass. Even for the structure of laminated glass and mesh glass, the surface is flat (smooth) and can be used safely. However, in areas exposed to direct sunlight for a long period of time (such as the Equatorial region), glass with steel wire or mesh, and Double Glazing and other films with a high heat absorption rate, heat cracking may occur. Please understand.

1. This window film is made of imported materials from Europe and America, healthy PET material, thicker than ordinary PVC material, more durable. 2. UV blocking window film can block UV rays, protect your skin from UV damage, reduce discoloration and aging caused by sunburn on furniture and flooring. 3. Heat control window film makes the room cooler, warmer in winter, and energy efficient. When the sun is strong (summer), it can greatly reduce the sunlight entering from the window, and use the UV barrier film to block the UV rays. In colder periods (winter), it acts as a heat insulator, reflecting infrared rays from the heater on the inside of the room and playing a "secondary role". The insulation film can reflect about 20%~30% of the heat source, making the room warmer and more comfortable. 4. Mirror window film has a unique mirror effect. At daytime, it looks like a mirror from the outside because of the brightness of the outside, and it protects the privacy by seeing the outside from inside. At night, when the interior is bright, you can see the interior from the outside, so you need to draw the curtains indoors at this time. 5. Window glass insulation film is anti-flyaway and has waterproof function. As long as the window film is applied to the window, the window glass will not fly apart even if it breaks. There is no need to worry about damage to important items by flying glass fragments. 6. As a decorative window film, it is fashionable both indoors and outdoors and has a decorative function. During the day, it reflects the clouds and the surrounding scenery like a mirror when viewed from outside. 7. This window film is easy to apply and is very versatile. It is suitable for use in hotels, government institutions, museums, banks, schools, commercial buildings, hospitals, foyers, flats, houses, etc. It can also be used in high rise buildings as it is installed from inside.
